item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -eu
echo "AGMS_RUN=$AGMS_RUN"
mkdir -p "$AGMS_RUN/evidence"
agms-probe all > "$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-executor.json"
rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
cat "$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-executor.json"
printf '"'\\n--- preflight-summary.json ---\\n'
cat \""'$AGMS_RUN/evidence/preflight-summary.json"
printf '"'\\n--- preflight files ---\\n'
for f in \""'$AGMS_RUN"/evidence/preflight-*.json; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done
printf '"'\\n--- package hash ---\\n'
shasum -a 256 /opt/agms/pkg/bin/corbanu
printf '\\n--- frozen case hashes ---\\n'
shasum -a 256 /opt/agms/packet/design-cases.md /opt/agms/packet/amendments-and-new-cases.md
printf '\\n--- UTC ---\\n'
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
